archetypes.description: Win someone over in an ordinary exchange: talk, ask, persuade, perform for one listener.
A demanding, high-stakes appeal that needs real expertise: treaties, court pleas, alliances.
Steady someone on your side: comfort, encourage, calm a panic.
Take the fight out of someone hostile without striking: show peaceful intent, talk them down.
Pressure someone with threat or presence, against their nerve.
Mislead someone, against their wits.
Read a person: their tells, motives and lies, against their composure.
Trade value or terms with someone.

crit_success.narrationHint: a deal well in your favour

archetypes.description: Lift everyone on your side at once; tiring, and not every turn.
Play to everyone present: music, a speech, a show.
Bring what you know to bear: lore, records, values, precedent.
Hard intellectual work that needs training: research, decipherment, diagnosis, legal craft.
Hunt for what is hidden: clues, details, a lead.
Take in what is plainly there to notice: watch, listen, survey.
Follow traces over ground: tracks, trails, game.

crit_success.narrationHint: the trail is plain as day

archetypes.description: Keep going in the wild: forage, shelter, fire, finding the way.
A feat of the body: climb, swim, leap, force, haul, endure.
Go unnoticed: sneak, hide, slip away, blend in, shadow someone.

failure.narrationHint: you are not sure you were seen

archetypes.description: Sleight of hand against someone's attention: lift, palm, plant.
Treat someone else's injuries with hands and supplies.
Patch up your own injuries.
Sustained skilled treatment that keeps healing over the next turns.
Make something useful from materials at hand.
Fix or restore something worn or broken.

crit_failure.narrationHint: you break it further and nick yourself

archetypes.description: Prepare a meal, remedy or mixture.
Ambitious, expert craft that needs training.

crit_failure.narrationHint: you ruin it and hurt yourself

archetypes.description: Work a machine or device as it was meant to be used.
Make a system do what it was not meant to; needs training and leaves traces.
A trained discipline that gates the demanding actions of its domain.
A natural way with people: a small, always-on edge in social checks.
A sharp eye for surroundings: a small, always-on edge in exploration checks.
Good hands: a small, always-on edge in crafting checks.
A tough constitution: +1 to the endurance attribute.
Light on your feet: +1 to the agility attribute.
Sustained concentration: +2 to exploration checks while held, at a stamina upkeep.
Turning the charm all the way up: +2 to social checks while held, at a stamina upkeep.
A weapon blow at close range.
A heavy, committed weapon blow that takes a moment to recover from.
A wide blow that catches several foes at once.
A shot or throw at a target in range.
A patient, aimed shot that takes a moment to line up again.
Fists, feet, teeth or claws.
Disrupt a foe's footing or grip, against their own.
Seize and hold a foe, against their strength.
Brace and defend for the next exchange.
Slip out of harm's way.
An automatic counterblow, fired by a reaction skill.
A single bolt of raw {element}.

archetypes.description: Weaken a foe's every effort, against their will.
Steal a foe's vitality for your own.
Close an ally's wounds with magic.
Heal everyone on your side at once.
Lay a slow, steady healing on an ally.
Shield an ally against harm and doubt.
A basic trained art that gates the ordinary actions of its school.
Fighting instinct: a small, always-on edge in combat checks.
Natural affinity for magic: +1 to the magic attribute.
A fighting stance: +2 to combat checks while held, at a stamina upkeep.
Answers any attack on you, hit or miss, with its paired action.
Answers any blow that actually hurts you with its paired action.
A weapon blow wreathed in an element the weapon carries.

params.name: element
params.description: What wreathes the weapon, as a noun: flame, frost, lightning.

archetypes.description: A shot the weapon drives through armour and cover.
A shot that leaves the target hobbled.
A blow that knocks the foe's guard and grip aside.
A spinning flurry that strikes every foe in reach.
A rapid volley loosed at several targets.
A blow that feeds the wielder some of what it takes.

success.narrationHint: the weapon drinks, and you with it

crit_failure.narrationHint: the weapon turns on its bearer
